title: OpenAIAgentOptions
description: Native Codex app-server initialize, thread, and turn arguments used by Captain's OpenAI agent runtime.

initialize.title: Initialize
initialize.description: Parameters sent in the Codex app-server initialize request.

clientInfo.title: Client information
clientInfo.description: Name, title, and version identifying the app-server client.

x-captain-option.note: Captain identifies itself and its build version to Codex.

capabilities.title: Client capabilities
capabilities.description: Experimental protocol capabilities supported by the client.

x-captain-option.note: Captain enables the experimental API required by its app-server integration.

threadStart.title: Thread start
threadStart.description: Parameters used to start a new Codex app-server thread.

cwd.title: Working directory
cwd.description: Initial working directory for the Codex thread.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model identifier used to start the Codex thread.

sandbox.title: Sandbox mode
sandbox.description: Named Codex sandbox mode for the thread.

approvalPolicy.title: Approval policy
approvalPolicy.description: Codex command-approval policy for the thread.

ephemeral.title: Ephemeral thread
ephemeral.description: Whether Codex avoids persisting the thread to disk.

config.title: Configuration overrides
config.description: Codex configuration overrides derived from Captain sandbox and caller-tool settings.

x-captain-option.note: Captain assembles sandbox and MCP overrides from mapped Spec values and its registered caller-tool endpoint.

experimentalRawEvents.title: Experimental raw events
experimentalRawEvents.description: Whether raw protocol events are included in item streams.

x-captain-option.note: Captain enables raw events to preserve provider-native session information.

allowProviderModelFallback.title: Provider model fallback
allowProviderModelFallback.description: Whether Codex may fall back to a different provider model.

x-captain-option.note: Captain performs model fallback in its own provider registry.

approvalsReviewer.title: Approvals reviewer
approvalsReviewer.description: Reviewer implementation used to evaluate approval requests.

baseInstructions.title: Base instructions
baseInstructions.description: Replacement base instruction text for the Codex thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain sends prompt instructions at turn start and does not replace Codex base instructions.

developerInstructions.title: Developer instructions
developerInstructions.description: Developer instruction text attached to the Codex thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not set thread-level developer instructions.

dynamicTools.title: Dynamic tools
dynamicTools.description: Tool definitions registered dynamically with the Codex thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain exposes caller tools through MCP rather than Codex dynamic tools.

environments.title: Environments
environments.description: Named execution environments available to the Codex thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not pass native Codex environment descriptors.

historyMode.title: History mode
historyMode.description: Codex policy controlling which history is retained.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not override Codex history mode.

mockExperimentalField.title: Mock experimental field
mockExperimentalField.description: Protocol test field reserved by the experimental app-server schema.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not use protocol test fields.

modelProvider.title: Model provider
modelProvider.description: Codex model-provider implementation selected for the thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain uses the installed Codex provider configuration.

multiAgentMode.title: Multi-agent mode
multiAgentMode.description: Codex multi-agent coordination mode for the thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not override Codex multi-agent mode.

permissions.title: Permission profile
permissions.description: Named Codex permission-profile identifier for the thread; it cannot be combined with sandbox.

x-captain-option.note: Captain maps sandbox and approvalPolicy explicitly and does not select native named permission profiles.

personality.title: Personality
personality.description: Named Codex response personality for the thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose Codex personality selection.

projectId.title: Project ID
projectId.description: Codex project identifier associated with the thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not set a native Codex project identifier.

runtimeWorkspaceRoots.title: Runtime workspace roots
runtimeWorkspaceRoots.description: Replacement runtime workspace roots for the Codex thread; paths must be absolute.

selectedCapabilityRoots.title: Selected capability roots
selectedCapabilityRoots.description: Filesystem roots selected for capability discovery.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not select native Codex capability roots.

serviceName.title: Service name
serviceName.description: Service identity attached to the Codex thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not send a Codex service name.

serviceTier.title: Service tier
serviceTier.description: Processing tier selected for the Codex thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not select a Codex service tier.

sessionStartSource.title: Session start source
sessionStartSource.description: Source label describing how the session was launched.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not override the native session-start source.

threadSource.title: Thread source
threadSource.description: Native source label attached to the Codex thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not set a Codex thread-source label.

threadResume.title: Thread resume
threadResume.description: Parameters used to resume an existing Codex app-server thread.

cwd.title: Working directory
cwd.description: Working directory applied when the thread is resumed.

config.title: Configuration overrides
config.description: Codex configuration overrides reconstructed for the resumed thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain rebuilds caller-tool MCP and workspace-write configuration when resuming.

approvalPolicy.title: Approval policy
approvalPolicy.description: Approval policy override applied while resuming the thread.

approvalsReviewer.title: Approvals reviewer
approvalsReviewer.description: Reviewer override applied to the resumed thread.

baseInstructions.title: Base instructions
baseInstructions.description: Replacement base instructions applied to the resumed thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not replace Codex base instructions on resume.

developerInstructions.title: Developer instructions
developerInstructions.description: Developer instructions attached while resuming a thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not send thread-level developer instructions on resume.

excludeTurns.title: Excluded turns
excludeTurns.description: Turn identifiers omitted when loading the resumed thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain resumes the complete stored Codex thread.

history.title: History
history.description: Replacement conversation history supplied while resuming.

x-captain-option.note: Captain asks Codex to load its native stored history.

initialTurnsPage.title: Initial turns page
initialTurnsPage.description: Pagination request controlling the initial resumed-turn page.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not customize resumed-thread pagination.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model override applied to the resumed thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain sends per-turn model selection instead of overriding the resumed thread.

modelProvider.title: Model provider
modelProvider.description: Model-provider override applied to the resumed thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain uses the provider recorded by Codex.

path.title: Rollout path
path.description: Filesystem path of the Codex rollout to resume.

x-captain-option.note: Captain resumes by thread ID rather than rollout path.

permissions.title: Permission profile
permissions.description: Named Codex permission-profile identifier applied to the resumed thread; it cannot be combined with sandbox.

x-captain-option.note: Captain reapplies sandbox and approvalPolicy explicitly and does not select native named permission profiles.

personality.title: Personality
personality.description: Response personality override applied to the resumed thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not override Codex personality on resume.

runtimeWorkspaceRoots.title: Runtime workspace roots
runtimeWorkspaceRoots.description: Replacement runtime workspace roots for the resumed thread; paths must be absolute.

sandbox.title: Sandbox mode
sandbox.description: Sandbox override applied while resuming the thread.

serviceTier.title: Service tier
serviceTier.description: Processing tier override applied to the resumed thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not select a service tier on resume.

turnStart.title: Turn start
turnStart.description: Parameters used to start a turn on an active Codex app-server thread.

threadId.title: Thread ID
threadId.description: Active Codex thread receiving the turn.

x-captain-option.note: Captain uses the identifier returned by thread/start or thread/resume.

input.title: Input
input.description: Text and local-image items supplied for the Codex turn.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model identifier used for this Codex turn.

effort.title: Reasoning effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort used for this Codex turn.

outputSchema.title: Output schema
outputSchema.description: JSON Schema constraining the final turn response.

additionalContext.title: Additional context
additionalContext.description: Extra context attached to the turn outside the user input list.

x-captain-option.note: Captain includes requested context in the prompt input.

approvalsReviewer.title: Approvals reviewer
approvalsReviewer.description: Reviewer override used for approvals in this turn.

clientUserMessageId.title: Client user message ID
clientUserMessageId.description: Client-assigned identifier for the turn's user message.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not assign native Codex message identifiers.

collaborationMode.title: Collaboration mode
collaborationMode.description: Codex collaboration mode applied for the turn.

cyberAccessProgram.title: Cyber access program
cyberAccessProgram.description: Codex cyber-access program configuration for the turn.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not configure native Codex cyber-access programs.

environments.title: Environments
environments.description: Execution environments made available for this turn.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not send Codex environment descriptors per turn.

multiAgentMode.title: Multi-agent mode
multiAgentMode.description: Codex multi-agent coordination mode for this turn.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not override native multi-agent mode.

permissions.title: Permission profile
permissions.description: Named Codex permission-profile identifier for this turn and subsequent turns; it cannot be combined with sandboxPolicy.

x-captain-option.note: Captain maps sandbox and approvalPolicy explicitly and does not select native named permission profiles.

personality.title: Personality
personality.description: Response personality override for this turn.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose Codex personality selection.

responsesapiClientMetadata.title: Responses API client metadata
responsesapiClientMetadata.description: Client metadata forwarded to the underlying Responses API call.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not attach Codex Responses API client metadata.

runtimeWorkspaceRoots.title: Runtime workspace roots
runtimeWorkspaceRoots.description: Replacement runtime workspace roots for this turn and subsequent turns; paths must be absolute.

sandboxPolicy.title: Sandbox policy
sandboxPolicy.description: Detailed sandbox policy override for this turn.

serviceTier.title: Service tier
serviceTier.description: Processing tier selected for this turn.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not select a Codex service tier.

serviceTierForTurn.title: Turn service tier
serviceTierForTurn.description: Whether a service tier applies only to this turn.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not set per-turn Codex service tiers.

summary.title: Reasoning summary
summary.description: Reasoning-summary mode requested for the turn.

x-captain-option.note: Captain maps effort but not the native reasoning-summary mode.

toolOutput.title: Tool output
toolOutput.description: Out-of-band tool output supplied with the turn-start request.

x-captain-option.note: Captain sends tool results through its standard turn input items.

turnTrigger.title: Turn trigger
turnTrigger.description: Source describing what triggered the Codex turn.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not set a native Codex turn-trigger label.
